name: Pixtights
source:
Main character belongs to HR department of the “Blue Company”. His job is to interview potential employees, and many women agree to undergo a full body test review. There is a cute graduate girl applying for a job. Protagonist needs to act carefully in order not to scare her, but swiftly and firmly to cut her escape routes.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2020/03/vn-of-month-october-2006-shuumatsu.html]vndbreview[/url]]
